name: Container ship
_about: a Panamax-sized container ship of ~4,000 TEU (built ~1995-2010): 220 m over all, 32.2 m beam, 19 m moulded depth, 12 m draught -- the hull lofted from its lines (dark topsides, red antifouling, a bulbous bow), the house aft with six decks of cabins, the bridge and its wings across the beam, the funnel, a free-fall lifeboat over the stern; twelve 40 ft bays forward on their hatch covers, 3 to 6 tiers, between lashing bridges; the forecastle, windlass, two stockless anchors in their hawse pockets, the rudder and the five-bladed screw
